part.text: I have implemented the `createPost` Server Action in `app/actions.ts` and `app/page.tsx` using `updateTag('posts')` from `'next/cache'`, which immediately expires the `"posts"` cache tag in a Server Action (read-your-own-writes) so subsequent requests wait for fresh data instead of serving stale cached content.
